# Pace Language Reference

## Top-level statements

- `var` — Defines a variable for interpolation in strings. Syntax: `var NAME = "value"`.
- `default` — Sets the default task that runs when Pace is invoked without a task name. Syntax: `default task_name`.
- `alias` — Defines a standalone task alias. Supported, but inline aliases (`task build [b] { ... }`) are preferred.
- `import` — Imports another Pace config file. Syntax: `import "path/to/file.pace"`.
- `hook` — Defines a reusable hook that can run before, after, or on task success/failure. Syntax: `hook name { ... }`.
- `task` — Defines a runnable Pace task. Syntax: `task name [alias] { ... }`.

## Task properties

- `description` (`string`) — Task description.
- `command` (`string`) — Command to execute.
- `depends-on` (`stringArray`) — Task dependencies (alias of dependencies).
- `dependencies` (`stringArray`) — Task dependencies (alias of depends-on).
- `requires` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run before task (preferred; alias of before).
- `before` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run before task (alias of requires).
- `triggers` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run after task (preferred; alias of after).
- `after` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run after task (alias of triggers).
- `on_success` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run on success.
- `on_failure` (`stringArray`) — Hooks to run on failure.
- `inputs` (`stringArray`) — Input file patterns.
- `outputs` (`stringArray`) — Output file patterns.
- `env` (`stringMap`) — Environment variables.
- `args` (`argsBlock`) — Command arguments.
- `cache` (`boolean`) — Enable caching (true/false).
- `parallel` (`boolean`) — Run dependencies in parallel (true/false).
- `silent` (`boolean`) — Suppress output (true/false).
- `watch` (`boolean`) — Enable watch mode (true/false).
- `continue_on_error` (`boolean`) — Continue on error (true/false).
- `timeout` (`string`) — Execution timeout.
- `retry` (`number`) — Number of retries.
- `retry_delay` (`string`) — Delay between retries.
- `working_dir` (`string`) — Working directory for the task command.
- `when` (`string`) — Condition that controls whether the task runs.

## Hook properties

- `description` (`string`) — Hook description.
- `command` (`string`) — Command to execute.
- `env` (`stringMap`) — Environment variables.
- `working_dir` (`string`) — Working directory for the hook command.

## Args properties

- `required` (`stringArray`) — Required arguments.
- `optional` (`stringArray`) — Optional arguments.
